items.title: Why Is American Tower (AMT) Adding A New Board Voice On Talent And Governance?
items.summary: American Tower (NYSE:AMT) appointed Kristen M. Ludgate to its Board of Directors and its Compensation and Human Capital Committee. Ludgate previously served as Chief People Officer at HP Inc. and held senior leadership roles at 3M. She also brings board experience from companies in the banking and technology sectors. items.summary: American Tower has seen its share price under pressure over the past few years, and that slide now puts a spotlight on whether the current US$174.60 level is still supported by the cash it generates. For a business built on long term tower leases and recurring payments, the core issue is how well those cash flows stack up against what the stock market is asking you to pay today.
